name: ReturnsAuthorisationDesk
tagline: Grade the item, let the policy decide the refund and send every return to the right place – restock, refurbish, vendor or outlet.
description: A complete returns authorisation app for Power Apps and Power Pages: receive online RMAs and in-store returns, grade the condition (A–D) and let the returns policy work out the refund – return window, warranty for faulty items, final-sale categories, receipt and gift-receipt rules, restocking fee, repeat-returner checks – with supervisor and manager approval levels, independent approval, refund method rules and a refund SLA, a refund queue for the POS / payments, and disposition to restock, refurbish, return to vendor, outlet or destroy with RTV lists and reason × category insights.
features: Condition grading A–D with refund % per grade
Return window and warranty (faulty items) rules
Receipt / online order / gift receipt / no-receipt rules and allowed refund methods
Restocking fee on opened items in chosen categories
Repeat-returner and high-value no-receipt fraud checks
Supervisor and manager approval levels with independent approval
Refund overrides need a manager and a note
Disposition rules (only grade A/B to the shelf, RTV needs a vendor)
Demo mode with a fictional department store
Phone card list and bottom view switcher
